summary: The market data socket's login is refused: the desktop sends no order subscription, reads no order book and does not connect again with the refused token; the web publishes nothing.

notes: Web 73599f37c (marketcalls/openalgo#2507, issue #2386): a refused token stands order updates down until the next broker login.
The desktop reports the refusal (FeedStatus::AuthFailed) and waits for a new login; its order catch-up reads only once a login is accepted.
